name: allegro-marketplaces-mcp
description: Allegro (marketplaces): me, list_products, get_product, update_price, list_sales, list_refunds. Ever

platform_mcp_allegro_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ALLEGRO_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_allegro_client_id.description: Client ID of your app registered at apps.developer.allegro.pl; sent with the secret as HTTP Basic on the token call.

platform_mcp_allegro_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ALLEGRO_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_allegro_client_secret.description: Client Secret of the same app.

platform_mcp_allegro_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ALLEGRO_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_allegro_refresh_token.description: Refresh token from a one-time authorization-code (or device-flow) consent of the seller account (valid 3 months). It is SINGLE-USE: every refresh returns a new pair (access token 12 h + new refresh token) and the old refresh token stops working 60 seconds after its first use. The runtime keeps a rotated refresh token in memory; set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR to also save it (<dir>/<platform>.json, mode 0600) so it is preferred over this variable on the next start. Without the state directory, a restart after the first refresh needs a fresh refresh token. The state file is keyed by platform id, so it is shared with ecommerce_channels/allegro: give each server its own PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR (or its own consent / refresh token) so the two never race on one single-use refresh token.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /me (scope allegro:api:profile:read) returns the authorised user {id, login, firstName, lastName, email, baseMarketplace, company}.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: GET /sale/offers?offset&limit(1-1000)&publication.status (INACTIVE|ACTIVE|ACTIVATING|ENDED; scope allegro:api:sale:offers:read) lists the seller's offers: {offers[{id, name, sellingMode.price {amount (decimal string), currency}, stock, stats, publication.status, primaryImage ...}], count, totalCount}. There is no description or URL in the list (see raw / get_product).

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: GET /sale/product-offers/{offerId} returns all data of the offer; `description` is a structured sections object (raw.description) and is not flattened, so the mapped description is null.

tools.name: update_price
tools.description: CHANGES THE LIVE PRICE: PATCH /sale/product-offers/{offerId} {sellingMode: {price: {amount (sent as the documented decimal string), currency}}} edits only the price; pass `currency` (PLN on allegro.pl). Answers 200 (edited, offer in the body) or 202 (accepted, still processing - the body may be empty and GET /sale/product-offers/{offerId}/operations/{operationId} tracks it).

tools.name: list_sales
tools.description: GET /order/checkout-forms?offset&limit(1-100)&lineItems.boughtAt.gte=`since` (ISO-8601 date-time) sorted newest first (scope allegro:api:orders:read). `amount` is summary.totalToPay (decimal string, whole order incl. delivery), product_id / product_name are the FIRST line item's offer; `status` is the purchase status (BOUGHT|FILLED_IN|READY_FOR_PROCESSING|CANCELLED). Orders cannot be filtered by offer: `product_id` is not sent.

tools.name: list_refunds
tools.description: GET /payments/refunds?offset&limit(1-100)&occurredAt.gte=`since` (ISO-8601 date-time; scope allegro:api:payments:read): refunds {id, payment.id, order.id, reason, status (WAITING|IN_PROGRESS|SUCCESS|CANCELED|...), totalValue {amount, currency}, lineItems, createdAt}. sale_id is the order (checkout form) id.
